summary: The note is titled "klook ad" and is a clipped web page for a Klook travel activity listing, but the excerpt has almost no readable content. Its only substantive information is in the body's data attribute: activity_id 5504, status published, tagged "Klook's choice", with sub-category 15 and leaf category 137. The rest is SVG icon and illustration markup (activity-selling graphics, account icons, arrows), which is boilerplate. The metadata lists the domain as earth_science, which does not match the travel-ad content.
one_line: A clipped Klook travel-activity ad page, mostly SVG markup, with metadata for published activity 5504 tagged "Klook's choice".
key_facts: The note is titled "klook ad" and has the source field "bright".
The note's metadata lists the domain as "earth_science", which does not match its travel-ad content.
The page body's data-spm-page attribute identifies the page as Activity with oid activity_5504.
The embedded activity_id is 5504 and the page_template_id is 1221.
The embedded status is "published", with sub_category_id 15 and leaf_category_id 137.
The embedded TagNameList contains the tag "Klook's choice" and PackageOptionType is "attribute".
The SVG defines a symbol with id "desktop-activity-crossing-selling-discount", a 169 by 116 illustration with a discount-tag graphic.
The SVG defines a symbol with id "desktop-activity-crossing-selling-hotel", a 196 by 116 illustration with a hotel building graphic.
The SVG includes account icons with ids such as desktop-common-account-bookings, desktop-common-account-coupons and desktop-common-account-wishlist.
The SVG includes navigation arrow icons, such as desktop-common-arrow-right and desktop-common-arrow-standard-down.
Apart from the SVG symbols and page attributes, the note contains no readable article text, so no claims about Klook's products or prices can be drawn from it.
The note is truncated in the middle of an SVG symbol definition (desktop-common-arrow-standard-up-new).
